desc: Raj, in a purple sweater, is eating his food very happily, smiling and closing his eyes in delight, at the canteen.
Sheldon is flickering his lips and twitching as he sits beside Howard, at the canteen.
Sheldon, in a blue shirt with orange sleeves, slams down his drink as he sits at the cafeteria table.
Kripke, in a brown plaid shirt, licks his lips, staring into the distance with a thoughtful expression, while standing next to Sheldon in the canteen.
Leonard and Penny, in a yellow blouse, are sitting on the couch together while Penny clicks something on her pink laptop.
Sheldon, in a blue shirt with orange sleeves, is pouring tea out of a red kettle while talking on the cell phone.
Penny, in a yellow blouse, makes a resigned face, eyes closed, mouth wide open, then buries her face in her hands on the couch with Leonard.
Leonard uses a blue cloth napkin to wipe a spot on the coffee table, while sitting on the couch next to Penny.
Sheldon, in a blue and purple shirt with green sleeves, walks into Penny's apartment behind her as she's reading the papers.
Penny, in a pink and floral blouse, is confused and annoyed about some papers she's looking at with Sheldon.
Sheldon, in a blue and purple shirt with green sleeves, points out something on Penny's papers and walk away.
Sheldon is working on some papers with a red marker, which makes Leonard, sitting at his computer, smirk.
Leonard closes the door to the fridge after taking out a bottle of water and spreads his arms wide with a bottle in his hand.
Sheldon, in a brown shirt with blue sleeves, takes the cap off of the red marker he is holding.
Sheldon, in a brown shirt with blue sleeves, gets up from the couch and put down a red marker on a glass table.
Sheldon, in a brown shirt with blue sleeves, talks to a lady in a brown sweater standing in line, and then she walks away.
Sheldon sits down on the green chair beside the little girl wearing a pink shirt, at the bookstore.
Leonard grabs Sheldon's arm to pull him away from a small table with a little girl.
Leonard, with a pretzel in his hand, walks up to a small table where happy Sheldon is sitting with a little girl.
Enthusiastic Sheldon, in a shirt with a colorful chevron pattern, points to the giant white board behind him that he has set up in the apartment.
Enthusiastic Sheldon, in a shirt with a colorful chevron pattern, walks over to his desk, picks up a book and hands it to Raj.
Sheldon, in a shirt with a colorful chevron pattern, walks up to a whiteboard and moves his finger across it, then switches to a marker.
Howard, in orange pants, grabs an eraser and erases lines on a whiteboard.
Sheldon, in a shirt with a colorful chevron pattern, is on his phone as he moves his finger across whiteboard.
Barry is being clipped in by the instructor in to the rock climbing rope.
Sheldon is being clipped in by the instructor to climb the wall.
A shot of stressed Sheldon looking up at the climbing wall from below.
Sheldon slowly moves up the tall climbing wall.
Sheldon scared, quickly pulls himself in and hugs the climbing wall.
Sheldon passes out on the rock wall, drops down on the rope, and hangs limply from it.
Raj, who is wearing a red hoodie, is sitting on the arm of Leonard's chair, leaning over and whispering in Leonard's ear.
Barry walks in, flossing his teeth, while Penny makes a disgusted face.
Howard, in purple pants, walks past Penny, leans in as he talks, and Penny puts her face in her hand laughing.
Sheldon snatches a container of dumplings from Barry and hands it to Raj.
A shot of Howard, Leonard, and Raj staring at Sheldon hanging from the ceiling in a harness.
